description: This file implements callback functions and handlers for WFA (Wi-Fi Alliance) data model tables, including get, add, remove, and sync handlers for network, SSID, APMLD, STAMLD, and affiliated STA tables. It also sets callback function pointers for these tables within a bus communication framework.

methods.name: get_wfa_dml_data_model_param
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the global WFA data model structure.

methods.name: wfa_elem_num_of_table_row
methods.description: Determines the number of rows for a given table based on the event name.

methods.name: wfa_network_get
methods.description: Handles get requests for network parameters.

methods.name: wfa_network_ssid_get
methods.description: Handles get requests for SSID parameters.

methods.name: wfa_apmld_get
methods.description: Handles get requests for APMLD group parameters.

methods.name: de_ssid_table_add_row_handler
methods.description: Handles adding a row to the SSID table.

methods.name: de_ssid_table_remove_row_handler
methods.description: Handles removing a row from the SSID table.

methods.name: de_device_table_add_row_handler
methods.description: Handles adding a row to the device table.

methods.name: de_device_table_remove_row_handler
methods.description: Handles removing a row from the device table.

methods.name: de_apmld_table_add_row_handler
methods.description: Handles adding a row to the APMLD table.

methods.name: de_apmld_table_remove_row_handler
methods.description: Handles removing a row from the APMLD table.

methods.name: de_sync_rows
methods.description: Synchronizes table rows by adding or removing rows to match the desired count.

methods.name: de_apmld_sync_handler
methods.description: Handles synchronization of the APMLD table.

methods.name: de_affap_sync_handler
methods.description: Handles synchronization of the Affiliated AP table.

methods.name: de_stamld_get
methods.description: Handles get requests for STAMLD parameters.

methods.name: de_stamld_sync_handler
methods.description: Handles synchronization of the STAMLD table.

methods.name: de_affsta_get
methods.description: Handles get requests for Affiliated STA parameters.

methods.name: de_affsta_sync_handler
methods.description: Handles synchronization of the Affiliated STA table.

methods.name: wfa_set_bus_callbackfunc_pointers
methods.description: Sets callback function pointers for WFA data model tables within the bus framework.
